issues.reason: `par` is a comparison standard the sentence never names, and *Core patterns* bars any atom whose words you cannot point at, so the MoreBy atom asserts a measured relation about an entity supplied purely by golf world knowledge (its scale slot additionally repeating the unit `stroke` rather than a dimension).

A bare-numeral score has no licensed encoding at all (the reviewer's own third gap), and `(Measure sk_score_1 score 64 stroke)` is true of the content and well-typed — "stroke" is even the sentence's own unit word — so the calibration line makes the implicit unit acceptable improvisation.

gaps_confirmed: Clause-level fronted participial adjunct ("Buoyed by ..., Howell shot ..."): the participial rule covers only noun post-modifiers, and no connective atom is licensed for a bare participial adjunct, so the two eventualities stay unrelated.
Object-experiencer psych verbs ("buoyed"): the role tests decide only subject-experiencer cases, leaving the affected object undecided between Patient and Experiencer.
Golf-score NPs: a bare numeral naming a score ("a 64") with a relative-to-par modifier ("8-under") has no licensed carrier for the number, its implicit unit, or the elided standard.
repair_summary: Removed the par_moreby atom; no licensed encoding records an elided comparison standard, and replacing it would mean inventing the referent again, so the "8-under" modifier is dropped and logged as the confirmed golf-score gap.
notes: Everything else — the mass partitive over "advice", the passive reduced relative, the by-phrase Agent on an inanimate cause, and the entity-attached (Over ...) — is licensed and untouched.
